title: Senior Lease Administration Analyst
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

About the Role

CoreWeave is seeking a Data Center Senior Lease Analyst to support the administration, accuracy, and ongoing optimization of our growing data center, real estate, and equipment lease portfolio. In this role, you will own complex lease administration activities, maintain lease data integrity, support ASC 842 / IFRS 16 and SOX compliance, and improve reporting and controls within our lease management system, CoStar.

You’ll partner closely with Accounting, Finance, Operations, Tax, Legal, and external landlords and brokers to ensure lease obligations are accurately captured, payments are processed appropriately, and critical dates and contractual requirements are effectively managed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interpreting complex agreements, solving problems, and improving processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

title: Customer Success & Operations Coordinator - 6 Month Contract
description:
Pourquoi Verifone 

Depuis plus de 40 ans, Verifone s'est imposé comme un leader incontesté de l'industrie des technologies de paiement électronique. Verifone est l'une des marques de référence en matière de solutions de paiement électronique et l'un des plus grands fournisseurs de systèmes de paiement électronique au monde. 

Verifone offre un environnement de travail diversifié, dynamique et rythmé, dans lequel les collaborateurs sont orientés résultats et disposent d'opportunités pour se dépasser. Nous sommes fiers de travailler avec les principaux commerçants, enseignes, banques et partenaires tiers afin de concevoir et de déployer des solutions de paiement innovantes à travers le monde. Nous visons l'excellence dans nos produits et nos services, et nous sommes obsédés par la satisfaction de nos clients. Partout dans le monde, les collaborateurs de Verifone font avancer l'industrie du paiement grâce à leur expérience, leur sens de l'innovation et leur esprit ambitieux. Qu'il s'agisse de développer la prochaine plateforme de systèmes de paiement sécurisés ou de chercher de nouvelles façons d'amener le paiement électronique vers de nouveaux marchés, l'équipe de Verifone se consacre à la réussite de ses clients, de ses partenaires et de ses investisseurs. C'est cette passion pour l'innovation qui anime chacun de nos collaborateurs dans sa réussite personnelle et professionnelle.

title: Principal Consultant (Enterprise Modernisation Architect)
description:
The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.

This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.

Job responsibilities

  • Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.
  • Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.
  • Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.
  • Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.
  • Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.
  • Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.
  • Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.
  • Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.
  • Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.
  • Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.
